description: WHO CITES a Romanian court decision: the decisions and acts that cite it, twenty a page, the binding ones (RIL, HP) first, each decision with the call that opens it. lookup_decision ends with the counts; this lists the documents behind them. Give the decision as lookup_decision takes it ("369/2017", "RIL 33/2008"), with court/year when the number is ambiguous. First-instance judgments are cited by number only and have no list. Only citations Ortexo could attribute with certainty are listed.

year.description: Optional year to disambiguate, as a string: "2019".

name: get_decision_citations
